subQuestions.questionText: Which ONE of the following file extensions represents a compressed file?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: D .zip (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Which ONE of the following is NOT netiquette?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B Not adding a subject line to the e-mail (1 mark)

options.B: Not adding a subject line to the e-mail
options.C: Make sure there are no large attachments
options.D: Be concise in the content of the e-mail

subQuestions.questionText: Which communication medium is used in a PAN?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: A Bluetooth (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Which statement about a touch screen is FALSE?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: C Unlimited simultaneous physical touches (1 mark)

options.A: Allows natural input, such as gestures
options.B: Serves as both a mouse and keyboard
options.D: Standard device on most mobile devices

subQuestions.questionText: What is the primary function of a firewall?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: A Protects against unauthorised access (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: If the display of text by a projector appears to be too light or too dark, the ... setting can be adjusted.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B contrast ratio (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A dedicated device which performs calculations and executes instructions necessary to display animations and videos:
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B GPU (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: What would the following paragraph setting be used for in a word processing document? (icon showing a line-spacing / paragraph-spacing control)
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: D To adjust spacing between lines of text (1 mark)

options.A: To adjust alignment of text between lines
options.B: To adjust spacing of text in a paragraph
options.C: To adjust indentation of text in a paragraph
options.D: To adjust spacing between lines of text

subQuestions.questionText: Why would some mobile users avoid a video call?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: C Rapidly reaches available cap (1 mark)

options.A: Cameras only capture and send images
options.D: Users are not concerned about privacy

subQuestions.questionText: Which ONE of the following criteria for a query will display ALL netball players who are NOT in Grade 10?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B Sport = "Netball" AND Grade <> 10 (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Provides battery backup only for a short period of time to prevent data loss. Choose the matching term from: A website, B crowd funding, C botnet, D ROM, E blogs, F COUNTIFS, G theme, H solar, I big data, J IF, K browser, L patch, M style, N zombie, O RFID, P service pack, Q NFC, R UPS, S RAM, T IoT.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: R UPS (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A compromised computer being remotely controlled by a hacker. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: N zombie (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The trend whereby different household devices are connected to one another. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: T IoT (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A software application used to view and explore pages on the web. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: K browser (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A wireless technology used to make wireless payments if the devices are close to the POS. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: Q NFC (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A type of memory that stores data and instructions permanently. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: D ROM (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Multiple software updates installed simultaneously. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: P service pack (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Online platforms where many people contribute to a project financially. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B crowd funding (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A feature that uses multiple settings to format an entire document with certain fonts, colour schemes and effects. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: G theme (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A spreadsheet function that chooses one of two options based on a condition. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: J IF (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): The snipping tool utility can be used to capture a portion of the screen.
subQuestions.memoText: True (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): Digital divide refers to the ongoing transformation of society and industry, driven by the convergence of digital, physical and biological technologies.
subQuestions.memoText: False, 4IR (1 mark). Candidates must supply the correct term (4IR) to earn the mark — the word FALSE alone is not enough.

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): The MAX function can be used to find the second highest value in a list.
subQuestions.memoText: False, Large (1 mark). Candidates must supply the correct function (LARGE) to earn the mark — the word FALSE alone is not enough.

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): Intellectual property refers to the ownership of an idea or design that is protected by copyright and patent laws.
subQuestions.memoText: True (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): The special character that prevents a line break from occurring between two words or characters is known as a non-breaking hyphen.
subQuestions.memoText: False, space (1 mark). Candidates must supply the correct term (space) to earn the mark — the word FALSE alone is not enough.

subQuestions.questionText: Learners at a school were provided with flash drives. Name the technology that automatically detects new hardware and installs a driver.
subQuestions.memoText: Plug-and-play (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: During which stage in the information processing cycle is a flash drive used?
subQuestions.memoText: Storage (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO reasons why a flash drive is NOT suitable for archiving files.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Smaller storage capacity; can easily be misplaced/lost/stolen; size-to-cost ratio is expensive per GB; better storage technology exists such as optical storage or magnetic tape. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO reasons why a motherboard is important.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Connects all the components; connects all peripherals/connection ports; allows communication between components/peripherals; provides power to components/peripherals. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Explain TWO uses of a recycle bin.
subQuestions.memoText: To temporarily store deleted files/folders; to recover files that were deleted. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: What do A and B represent in the path C:\MYSTUFF\BUDGET.XLSX, where A marks the C: portion and B marks the MYSTUFF portion of the path?
subQuestions.memoText: A: Drive (C:); B: Folder (folder name, MYSTUFF). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A school must have a backup policy to prevent data loss. Explain TWO ways in which data loss can take place.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Hardware failure (hard drive crashes, power surges, other hardware malfunctions); malware (viruses, ransomware, or other malicious software corrupting or deleting data); accidental deletion (users accidentally deleting files or formatting storage devices); natural disasters (fires, floods, or other disasters damaging equipment and data). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Suggest TWO guidelines that must be included in a backup policy regarding storage media.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Do not store the backup in the same location as the original data; specify the storage media; backup to multiple types of media/make multiple backups. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Explain what a Creative Commons (CC) licence is.
subQuestions.memoText: A copyright agreement that allows anyone to use and share the content under certain conditions (e.g. free) from the copyright holder/owner. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO ways of locating a video file if the user is unsure of the date on which the file was saved.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Search by file type/extension; search by file name/portion of name; check the 'Recent Files' list in the application used to download or save the video. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Name the accessibility feature that is available for users experiencing challenges pressing multiple keys on a keyboard.
subQuestions.memoText: Sticky keys / Filter keys / Toggle keys (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: What does the term ergonomically designed mean?
subQuestions.memoText: Devices/equipment that is designed to be comfortable and prevent health issues. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Your monitor's light is on, but nothing displays on the monitor. Give TWO troubleshooting tips you can follow to solve the problem.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Check that the computer is switched on; check the connection cables; check the brightness and contrast ratio settings; check the signal input button; check if the graphics card is faulty. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Explain the process used by a 3D printer to create objects.
subQuestions.memoText: Reads the design from a file/digital model of the item, by gradually layering the material in thin layers on top of one another. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: What is a podcast?
subQuestions.memoText: A podcast is a series of pre-recorded audio or video files that a user can download or stream to a computer or mobile device for listening/viewing. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Name TWO services, apart from internet access, that an ISP can offer.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Personalised e-mail addresses with their internet service; web hosting services (create and host websites); bundle security software/services with their internet packages; customer support for troubleshooting internet connectivity issues. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Explain ONE effect that an acceptable use policy (AUP) has on a user when using streaming services.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: Prohibits access to inappropriate content; limits excessive streaming to preserve network performance; prevents unauthorised sharing of streaming accounts. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Discuss ONE benefit and ONE limitation of using cloud computing.
subQuestions.memoText: Benefit (any ONE): access files/applications from anywhere with an internet connection; save local storage space/no need to carry a storage device; collaboration and sharing of files; work with the latest updated versions; usable on a variety of platforms; robust data backup and recovery services; cost savings; synchronisation features. Limitation (any ONE): slow internet connection may cause apps to load slower/not refresh on time; you no longer have control over security and backup; uploading/saving to cloud can use up data; free versions have limited storage/features/support. (2 marks — one benefit, one limitation)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO disadvantages of purchasing from an online store rather than a physical store.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Potentially a fake online shop; product might not be the same as advertised; product could be damaged during transport; hidden costs e.g. import tax; enforcement of the return policy might be difficult; clothing cannot be fitted for size; one cannot physically feel the quality of the product. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Name any TWO mobile internet technologies that can be used for connecting remotely to a company's network.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: LTE (4G/5G); WiFi hotspot; WiMax/Bluetooth (via a dongle). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Which TWO aspects should you consider when creating a website such that it is accessible to visually impaired users?
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Colour schemes/high contrast; readability/web pages not too busy; audio comments/sound for navigation and feedback. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Explain TWO reasons why incognito/in-private browsing benefits a user.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Browsing activity is not saved in the browser history; cookies and site data are deleted after closing the session; prevents leaving personal data on shared computers; autofill details like usernames and passwords are not stored; third-party cookies are blocked, reducing tracking by advertisers; allows signing into multiple accounts on the same site simultaneously; helps check how websites appear to new visitors. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A user uses a URL shortening service. State TWO benefits of using a URL shortening service.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Easier to use than typing or remembering the URL; shortened URLs can be customised; enhanced tracking and analytics; provide a more professional appearance. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Name TWO elements of a report that must be included in your final practical assessment task (PAT) report.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Cover page; table of contents/figures; introduction; body; discussion; findings/recommendations; conclusion; bibliography. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO criteria you should consider when evaluating the reliability of an online source.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Authority; accuracy; currency; objectivity; coverage. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: When working on your PAT, it is important to create a suitable folder structure. State TWO factors that you need to consider when creating your folder structure.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Start by creating a main folder; the names of the folders and files should be meaningful; ensure there is a variety of folders created that cater for all categories of files to be saved; each phase needs to have its own subfolder. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Study the chart below showing a summary of responses on a questionnaire, with four unlabelled clustered-column groups (each showing two bars, Series1 and Series2) under the generic heading 'Chart Title', plotted against the questions: 'Do you know what protection of privacy is?', 'Do you think the 4th Industrial Revolution is controlling the future?', 'Is it necessary for a person to share his/her personal details with known and unknown people?', and 'Do you store or save passwords on your device?'. The y-axis is unlabelled and only shows numeric gridlines from 0 to 5. Give TWO reasons why it is difficult to interpret the chart.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: No clear indication of what the questionnaire is about/no title is indicated; no axis labels indicated; no data labels provided; legend is meaningless (Series1/Series2 do not say what they represent). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Define the term click-jacking.
subQuestions.memoText: Users are tricked into clicking on an item on a web page which acts as a concealed link. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Name and briefly describe ONE type of e-mail threat.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE (one mark for the type, one for the explanation): Phishing (deceptive e-mails that try to trick users into revealing personal information); spam (unsolicited bulk e-mails, often used for advertising or spreading malware); malware (e-mails that contain attachments or links that install malicious software on the recipient's computer); spoofing (altering an e-mail header so the message appears to have come from someone other than the actual sender). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Discuss TWO ways in which you can protect yourself from online harassment.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Use strong privacy settings on social media and other online platforms; avoid sharing personal information or engaging with online bullies; do not make a controversial post that can lead to online harassment. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Describe TWO privacy issues that individuals can experience when businesses use their information in big data.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Excessive personal data collection without individuals' consent; sharing personal data with third parties; creating detailed profiles of individuals based on their data; monitoring individuals' activities without their knowledge. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Briefly explain TWO long-term impacts of software piracy on the global software industry.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Financial losses (reduced revenue, increased costs, higher prices for legitimate users); security risks (malware and viruses, system instability, data breaches, loss of trust, ethical concerns); lack of technical support; not qualifying for updates and upgrades. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State the action you have to perform in a word processing document prior to creating an automatic table of figures displaying all diagrams.
subQuestions.memoText: Add captions to the figures/diagrams/images. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: State the action you have to perform in a word processing document prior to creating an automatic index to display an alphabetic list of words.
subQuestions.memoText: Mark the entries on all words to be included in the index. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: What is the difference between an embedded object and a linked object?
subQuestions.memoText: Embedded object: not linked to the source document; opens as a separate/independent document. Linked object: linked to the source document; updates with data from the original source document before opening. (2 marks, one per row of difference)

subQuestions.questionText: A teacher captured learners' marks in a spreadsheet: column B has learner names, column C has Percentage, column D has Level (1-7), e.g. 29% → Level 1, 33% → Level 2, 47% → Level 3, 56% → Level 4, 65% → Level 5, 73% → Level 6, 82% → Level 7. Name a function, other than a LOOKUP function, that was used to determine the correct level for each percentage.
subQuestions.memoText: Nested IF-statement. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Which spreadsheet feature was used to complete the list of numbers (1 to 7) in column A?
subQuestions.memoText: AutoFill/Fill series. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: You received a spreadsheet from a friend, but can only enter data in certain cells. You receive a pop-up message when trying to work in other cells. Give ONE reason why you are only able to work in certain cells.
subQuestions.memoText: The cells are protected and only the unprotected cells can be worked in. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A database table storing records of learners participating in various sports has fields: Surname (Short Text), Date_Of_Birth (Date/Time), Age (Number), SportType (OLE Object). Suggest a more suitable data type for the SportType field.
subQuestions.memoText: Short Text/Lookup. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Why should you NOT make the field size of the Surname field less than 10?
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: If the field is edited, all characters after the specified size will be lost; new records will not be able to store surnames exceeding 10 characters. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Study the screenshot of a conditional formatting rule in a spreadsheet: 'Format values where this formula is true' contains =A1:A5 >= AVERAGE($A$1:$A$5). Briefly explain the result of the rule that was applied to cells A1:A5.
subQuestions.memoText: Formatting is applied (e.g. shading) to cells A1:A5 where the value of a cell is greater than or equal to the average of the range A1:A5. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Study the HTML code used to place the image Well done.jpg on a web page: They brought us pride . Give TWO reasons for setting the width and height attributes in the image tag.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: To change the size of the image/to ensure correct proportions in any browser or resolution; the original image does not have the right aspect ratio; to improve the layout of the webpage. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Why would the image NOT display on the web page?
subQuestions.memoText: The file extension is missing (the src value 'Well done' has no .jpg extension). (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: What does "#Stars" in the ... tag refer to?
subQuestions.memoText: #Stars is a bookmark on the webpage. (1 mark)

questions.title: Integrated Scenario — Coding and Robotics Club

subQuestions.questionText: Mr Brown is establishing a coding and robotics club at the school, consisting of learners from all grades and volunteer teachers. The club needs laptops. Mr Brown submitted two quotations: Quotation 1 (15.6" FHD IPS 165 Hz display, 16 GB RAM and 1 TB HDD, Intel Core i5-1135G7 4 cores 2.4-4.2 GHz, 802.11 b/g/n, 3-year warranty on registration, free AVG Antivirus, Windows 11, Office 2019, Scratch software) and Quotation 2 (14.0" 16:10 OLED display, 32 GB RAM and 1 TB SSD, Intel Core i7-1255U 10 cores 1.7-4.7 GHz, 802.11 b/g/n, 3-year warranty on registration, free AVG Antivirus, Windows 11, Office 365, MakeCode software). Which operating system is installed on both laptops?
subQuestions.memoText: Windows. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO functions of an operating system.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Manages and controls the hardware; manages and controls the software; provides a user interface; organising and managing files and folders; provides basic security; input/output management; memory management; device management. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO reasons why Quotation 2 is better than Quotation 1.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: It has more primary memory (RAM) that can be utilised; SSD is faster since it is electronic (vs HDD); it has more cores to process instructions from the RAM which will result in faster processing; Office 365 has the latest features (vs Office 2019). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: What is the purpose of the 802.11 specification?
subQuestions.memoText: The laptops have the ability to connect to a wireless network. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: State ONE disadvantage that can be associated with using the type of antivirus indicated in the quotations (free AVG Antivirus).
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: Limited technical support; many different versions; may contain malware in certain versions; no guarantee that the free anti-virus will not corrupt your computer system; additional pop-up advertisements. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The new laptops need to be set up in a network. Why is a WAN NOT a suitable type of network for these computers?
subQuestions.memoText: The computers are in a small geographic area (school lab). (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Suggest a network communication medium that the club can use. Motivate your answer.
subQuestions.memoText: Wireless connection (any ONE reason): less clutter; devices can easily be added; mobility. OR Wired connection (any ONE reason): less prone to interference; constant/stable transmission speed (UTP); no electrical interference and faster (Fibre optic). (2 marks — one for the type of connection, one for the reason)

subQuestions.questionText: Explain TWO ways in which the club can ensure ethical use of the network.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Ensure that each user has a unique log-in with strong passwords; different users will have different access rights/review user permissions; change password regularly; clearly inform club members about network policies and data usage. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The learners are allowed to bring their own computing devices (BYOD) for their projects. State TWO disadvantages of BYOD for the club.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Learners' devices can get stolen; compatibility problems with operating system, hardware or software; personal devices may contain apps or games that distract learners from their work; increasing the risk of malware spreading over the network; difficult to control data usage; not all learners may have their own device; security cannot be enforced on all devices (different operating systems/software/hardware versions); may cause bottleneck on the network; possible for learners to access sensitive data on the network. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A learner's device does not respond when he/she tries to open a video file. State TWO ways in which this problem can be resolved.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Update software/re-install software; close unused tasks on device; restart the device; use an alternative video player; update codecs; convert to another video format. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: An incomplete spreadsheet captures total hours spent at the club across Weeks 1-4, Monday to Friday. To calculate the total number of hours spent at the club on Mondays, the function =SUMS(B3:B6) was entered in cell B7, but it gives an error message. What does the #NAME? error message in cell B7 indicate?
subQuestions.memoText: The function is typed incorrectly/there is a spelling error in cell B7 (SUMS instead of SUM). (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The spreadsheet data is copied into a word processing document, but not all the columns are visible on the page. Without changing the font size, state TWO ways in which the learners can adjust the table so that all the columns appear.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Adjust column widths; AutoFit to content; change page orientation to landscape; adjust page margins. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Spreadsheet data will be displayed within the body section of an HTML document. What is the purpose of the <body> tag in HTML?
subQuestions.memoText: The <body> tag in HTML contains the content that will be displayed in the browser window. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Learners use online social networks to do research and to solve problems. State TWO advantages of being part of online social networks.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Wide range of expertise; can provide immediate feedback; enhances collaborative problem solving. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Why is cybersecurity important while learners are using online social networks?
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: Protect learners' devices from malware and hacking; crucial to safeguard sensitive data; prevent unauthorised access. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: During the competition, plagiarism leads to immediate disqualification. Briefly explain the concept plagiarism.
subQuestions.memoText: Plagiarism is the act of using someone else's work or ideas and presenting them as your own without giving proper credit. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A welcoming committee needs to organise an orientation week for 150 Grade 8 learners, who will be placed into specific groups for different activities. The committee chairperson will do a presentation at the welcoming ceremony in the school hall using a laptop. Name TWO additional hardware devices that the chairperson will need during the welcoming ceremony.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Data projector; pointing device; smart board; microphone; speakers. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Identify an appropriate type of application software that can be used during the welcoming ceremony in the hall. Motivate your answer.
subQuestions.memoText: Presentation software — allows the team leader to create visually engaging slides with text, images and multimedia. (Any other applicable software with a suitable motivation is also accepted.) (2 marks — one for the type, one for the motivation)

subQuestions.questionText: While preparing for the welcoming ceremony, the chairperson tries to shut down the laptop and receives a message that updates are running. Discuss TWO possible consequences if the laptop is switched off while the updates are being installed.
subQuestions.memoText: The download or install process will be interrupted, causing errors or corruptions in the software. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The Grade 8 learners will be divided into their different groups. The details of the Grade 8 learners will be captured into a database. Which TWO objects in a database can be used to capture the Grade 8 learners' information?
subQuestions.memoText: Table; Form. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A database table has to be exported into a spreadsheet. Name TWO factors to consider before exporting a database table to a spreadsheet.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Make sure that the data types are suitable for a spreadsheet; any formatting and layout should display as is within the spreadsheet; select records to be exported; verify the potential limitations when exporting a very large number of records; ensure that if the spreadsheet will be used for calculations, the exported data is suitable for spreadsheet functions. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Each Grade 8 learner will receive a personalised letter to indicate in which group they are placed. Which word processing feature can the welcoming committee use to quickly generate the letters for all Grade 8 learners?
subQuestions.memoText: Mail merge. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The committee will use augmented reality to create a guided tour of the school for the different groups. Discuss TWO benefits of using augmented reality instead of virtual reality for the guided tour.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: No additional equipment required (e.g. VR goggles); accessible to more learners; augmented reality allows for direct interaction with the real-world/actual school while receiving digital overlays. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The welcoming committee is planning an online gaming day in the ICT centre. Explain the concept of broadband.
subQuestions.memoText: Refers to a high-speed, always-on internet connection. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO reasons why the school should have a large bandwidth available for playing online games.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: To ensure an online gaming experience without any lagging or buffering; there will be many learners participating online simultaneously that will require sufficient bandwidth; to accommodate online multiplayers allowing learners to play together seamlessly; a robust internet connection ensures a more enjoyable and engaging experience for learners. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The welcoming committee needs to provide school management with a report on the orientation week. Suggest TWO data gathering tools that can be used to get direct feedback from the Grade 8 learners.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Survey (online or paper-based); interview; WhatsApp poll. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO ways in which to ensure that the data collected is free from errors before analysis is started.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Use controls (combo boxes/checkboxes/drop-down list/date picker, etc); avoid open-ended questions; administer the survey to the correct or suitable participants. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Drones will be used to capture videos of all the outdoor activities. State TWO limitations that can be experienced when using drones for video capture.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Limited battery life; potentially poor camera quality; potentially low storage capacity; risk of flying drones over people. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A video with all the highlights will be created and uploaded to the school's website. The link will be e-mailed to the parents, using a distribution list. State TWO advantages of using a distribution list.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Saving time by just typing in the group name; more accuracy/cannot leave out certain addresses; message is sent simultaneously to different recipients. (2 marks)
